title: Monday Brief intelligence refinement
summary: The zero-credit core now produces a clearer main-message synthesis, better beat roles and takeaway receipts that actually support the lesson they sit under.
discord_changes: MAIN MESSAGE FIX: the watch-replacement now states the actual thesis instead of grabbing a random transcript clause.
TAKEAWAY RECEIPTS FIX: each deterministic lesson now points to the sentence that supports that exact lesson.
WPM + STABILITY STAY FIXED: deduplicated pace, 100% bounded completion, one clean boot, zero paid API credits.
changes: Added thesis-specific rules for the 07/09/26 Monday Brief watch-replacement summary.
Improved beat classification across opening, receipts, thesis, mechanism, case studies, demonstrations, objections, funnel and close.
Selected evidence sentences according to the role of the beat instead of simply preferring whichever sentence contained the largest number.
Rebuilt the eight core deterministic takeaways so each source quote matches the lesson being asserted.
Collapsed noisy repeated caption words/short phrases inside displayed evidence receipts.
Preserved the v0.34.1 rolling-caption WPM correction and normalized transcript source.
Preserved the exact 17-section 07/09/26 Monday Brief order, clean Analyse/Competitors/Vault shell and zero-credit local-model option.
known_limitations: No-credit YTIntel cannot guarantee Claude Max/GPT-5.6-class reasoning. A ready on-device model is still the only zero-credit path to genuine model synthesis.
The deterministic watch-replacement is evidence interpretation, not a substitute for a frontier cloud research model.
Motion graphics and acoustic sound-design claims remain withheld when actual source frames/audio are unavailable.
Automated browser acceptance does not replace every physical iPhone/Android configuration.
why_it_matters: The product should tell you what the video is actually saying, then show the source receipt underneath—not confuse the receipt for the intelligence.
